svg.title: AIcoach landing — broadcast telestrator
svg.text: HIPS TOWARD THE BALL: 7% OF BODY HEIGHT (THRESHOLD 4%)

text.tspan: SEE WHAT
YOUR SWING
ACTUALLY DID.
It may feel like you stay down. The replay says otherwise.
Film one swing down the line and AIcoach breaks it down
like an analysis segment: what the fault is, where it comes
from, how sure it is, and one drill to fix it.

svg.text: Web app — runs in your phone browser at the range. Practice tool only.

text.tspan: of body height
toward the ball

svg.text: every number carries a confidence band

text.tspan: ONE SWING IN.
A FULL ANALYSIS SEGMENT OUT.
AIcoach tracks your body pose frame by frame, finds address,
top and impact, and measures what the rule table needs. Then it
tells you what a good coach would — in plain language.

svg.text: Not measurable directly. Lead hip turned 31° at impact vs ~45° typical.
Measured: 7% of body height. Key frames: address + impact.
Decided by the rule table. The AI only explains it.

text.tspan: Most swing apps hand you a list of deviations. AIcoach shows how sure it is about
every number, and stops when the video can’t support an answer.
Body points clearly visible, swing events clear, value well
away from the threshold.
Something is less clear. Over the top stays here while it is
measured from the hand path.
Read with care. You get a note on what to film better.

svg.text: Clips under 120 fps never get “high” on any measurement.

text.tspan: Bad video gets no guess. You get each reason, linked to the filming guide step that fixes it.
If your swing doesn’t match one of the three rules, we say so instead of forcing a fault
onto it.
Anything outside the rule table is labelled, carries confidence: low, and never gets a drill.
FILM DOWN
THE LINE
Phone behind you at hand height, 2.4–3.7 m
away, on your bag or a tripod. 120 fps or more,
whole body and club in frame, one swing.
UPLOAD ONE
CLIP
mp4 or mov, up to 15 s, straight from your phone
browser. Unsaved swing clips are deleted after
analysis.
WATCH THE
BREAKDOWN
The fault, its fault chain, a confidence band on
every number, one drill and one mobility
exercise. Then ask the analyst.

svg.text: THREE FAULTS. VERIFIED BY A RULE TABLE.

text.tspan: Hips move toward the ball, address → impact
Posture angle change in the downswing vs address

svg.text: Weak hip hinge or tight hamstrings
White = address posture line. Orange = downswing.

text.tspan: Hand path in transition above the backswing path

svg.text: Confidence capped at medium: measured from the hand path.
Not one of the three? You get “No verified fault found” — never a forced fit.
Why does it feel like I’m staying down when I’m not?

text.tspan: Your upper body keeps its bend, so it feels like you stay down. But the impact frame shows
your hips moved toward the ball by 7% of your body height. The wall drill lets you feel the
difference.

svg.text: Answers are based only on this analysis.

text.tspan: PUT YOUR SWING
ON THE REPLAY.

svg.text: Practice tool only — not for use during a competitive round. · The example result uses synthetic demo data. · Delete any analysis, or your account, at any time.
